description: Phase 6 controlled no-training A/B. Six representative prompts, fixed seed per prompt, one variable changed per variant. Duration is 60 s because Phase 5 established 30 s as the structurally weakest tier; 30 s is retained only as a regression cell elsewhere.

variants.description: Phase 5 baseline behaviour: compiler appends conditioning unconditionally (duplicated).
Phase 6 de-duplicated compiler. Only variable vs V1 is the prompt text.
Dedup compiler plus bpm / key_scale / time_signature conditioning, which LUBER has never sent.
Dedup compiler with infer_method=sde instead of the default ode sampler.

composition_note: 2 Korean K-pop vocal (KPOP-01 simple, KPOP-02 detailed/complex), 1 Korean ballad, 1 Korean R&B, 1 English vocal (ROCK-04), 1 instrumental (JAZZ-01).
